claims.claim: Patrick Wardle of the Objective-See Foundation disclosed an unpatched flaw in Meta's Muse macOS client that lets unprivileged local software overwrite the preference endo_voyager_dictation_endpoint and redirect dictation audio and the account token.
claims.episode_span: Software running as an ordinary user can overwrite an undocumented preference, endo_voyager_dictation_endpoint
claims.source_title: Meta AI Assistant Bypasses Apple's Permission Barrier via Innovative Workaround
claims.supporting_quote: The vulnerability stems from an undocumented configuration preference key named endo_voyager_dictation_endpoint.

claims.claim: Wardle demonstrated a proxy that forwarded Muse dictation traffic to Meta while capturing authentication tokens and audio, and described prompt injection that could steal local documents or WhatsApp records.
claims.episode_span: Wardle ran a proxy that forwarded traffic on to Meta while keeping the token and the audio.
claims.source_title: Meta AI Assistant Bypasses Apple's Permission Barrier via Innovative Workaround
claims.supporting_quote: Wardle demonstrated how an attacker can run a proxy server to seamlessly forward normal traffic back to Meta's servers while capturing authentication tokens and audio data, thus avoiding detection.

claims.claim: Meta has not released an official security advisory for the Muse flaw, and it has no official CVE ID.
claims.episode_span: Meta has not issued a security advisory, the flaw has no CVE ID
claims.source_title: Meta AI Assistant Bypasses Apple's Permission Barrier via Innovative Workaround
claims.supporting_quote: As the company has not released an official security advisory nor coordinated with the CVE number assigning authority, the vulnerability does not have an official CVE ID at present.

claims.claim: AQPotency from SandboxAQ is available to AWS commercial customers in North America on the AWS Marketplace and deployable on Amazon SageMaker, ranking millions of compounds in a few hours from a UniProt ID and SMILES strings without a 3D structure.
claims.episode_span: SandboxAQ's AQPotency is available to AWS commercial customers in North America through the AWS Marketplace
claims.source_title: AQPotency Available To AWS Customers In North America
claims.supporting_quote: AQPotency is available to AWS commercial customers in North America through the AWS Marketplace.

claims.claim: Eliyan, backed by AMD, Cisco, and Meta, is drawing takeover interest as chipmakers try to solve data-transfer bottlenecks slowing AI systems.
claims.episode_span: Eliyan, backed by AMD, Cisco, and Meta, is drawing takeover interest, The Information reports.
claims.source_title: Eliyan Draws Takeover Interest Backed by AMD, Cisco, Meta
claims.supporting_quote: Backed by AMD, Cisco and Meta, Eliyan is drawing takeover interest as chipmakers race to solve the data-transfer bottlenecks slowing down AI systems.

claims.claim: Google tested a Gemini 4 variant called Carbon on the internal coding platform Jetski, where an employee compared it to Anthropic's Opus 5.5, and Vedant Misra replied about recursive self improvement.
claims.episode_span: Google has put a Gemini 4 checkpoint called Carbon on its internal coding platform Jetski
claims.source_title: Google's Gemini 4 "Carbon" model is reportedly matching Anthropic's Opus 5.5 coding performance
claims.supporting_quote: Carbon was deployed on Google's internal coding platform Jetski over the past few days and is said to beat Argon mainly on programming tasks.

claims.claim: Amazon reshuffled Alexa leadership following a high-end tablet release, and a Yahoo Finance headline asked whether Alexa+ can move a 53 billion dollar subscription business.
claims.episode_span: Amazon reshuffled Alexa leadership after releasing a high-end tablet, Reuters reported.
claims.source_title: Amazon Reshuffles Alexa Leadership: Can Alexa+ Move a $53 Billion Subscription Business?
claims.supporting_quote: Amazon Reshuffles Alexa Leadership: Can Alexa+ Move a $53 Billion Subscription Business?

claims.claim: Mark Gurman says U.S. Apple Stores will personalize the iPhone Duo boot screen with the buyer's name in English or Spanish, with pre-orders on October 16 at 5 a.m. Pacific, launch on October 23, and pricing from 1,999.
claims.episode_span: U.S. Apple Stores will have a system that puts the buyer's name on the iPhone Duo's first Hello screen
claims.source_title: Apple Stores Will Add Your Name to iPhone Duo's Startup Screen
claims.supporting_quote: The iPhone Duo will be available for pre-order starting on October 16 at 5 a.m. Pacific Time, and it will launch on October 23. Pricing starts at 1,999.
